description: Profile C semantic state verification vectors. Tests computeStateHash comparison at guard step 10. Two hash strategies are modelled: 'core' (sha256HexFromJson — standard OxDeAI) and 'provider' (SHA-256 of 'PROVIDER:' + canonicalJson — simulates siftCanonicalJsonHash or equivalent external provider algorithm). Encoding B vectors additionally exercise Sift-compatible wire format (alg='ed25519', expires_at, base64url signature) combined with live-state semantic verification.

vectors.description: Core-native strategy: same state at signing and verification produces matching state_hash. Profile C step 10 passes.
Core-native strategy: state advanced between signing and execution. Live state produces a different hash than committed state_hash. Profile C step 10 fails with state-hash-mismatch.

Hash-strategy mismatch: provider algorithm committed at signing, Core algorithm used at verification. Even with the same state, hashes differ. Profile C step 10 fails. This is the 'missing computeStateHash configuration' failure mode.

expected.reason: provider hash committed; Core strategy used at verification produces a different hash

vectors.description: computeStateHash throws: the configured hash function raises an exception. The guard must catch this and block execution — fail-closed. No state comparison is possible.

TOCTOU / stale state: authorization issued against an earlier state; live state has since advanced significantly. Core hash of live state does not match committed hash. Profile C step 10 detects the staleness.

expected.reason: TOCTOU: live state has advanced since authorization was issued

vectors.description: Encoding B (Sift-compatible wire format: alg='ed25519', expires_at, base64url sig) + provider hash strategy, matching state. Full Profile C: signature verified via Encoding B path, then live-state hash verified with provider strategy. Both pass.

Encoding B (Sift-compatible) + provider hash strategy, stale state. Signature valid (Encoding B path passes), but live state has advanced. Provider hash of live state does not match committed provider hash. Profile C step 10 fails.

expected.reason: Encoding B auth: live state mismatch detected at Profile C step 10

vectors.description: Encoding B + hash-strategy mismatch: provider algorithm committed at signing, Core algorithm used at verification. Signature verifies correctly (Encoding B path), but state_hash computed with Core strategy differs from committed provider hash. Profile C step 10 fails — ambiguous config is rejected fail-closed.

expected.reason: Encoding B auth: computeStateHash strategy mismatch produces different hash
